title: The AI Bubble Is Popping
creator: Joseph Carlson After Hours
summary: Joseph Carlson reviews 15 years of Ray Dalio and Michael Burry's market calls against outcomes: both were right in 2008, but their bearish calls from 2010-2017 would have cost investors massive compounding (2013 exit misses +32%/+13%/+21% gains); Burry's index-bubble warnings in 2019 preceded a +31.5% year. He shows the S&P was positive in 16 of 19 years since 2007 and argues bubble-timing destroys more wealth than crashes — 'the market will drop 20-30% every 5-7 years; pencil it in.' His verdict: ignore the crash calls, hold profitable wide-moat compounders (his own: Google at 24x P/E, Amazon 25x, Meta 22x, Microsoft at a historically low 25x fwd — 'not high valuations'), and treat any bubble pop as a buying opportunity. Also recounts a 45-min interview on Steve Eisman's Substack playbook. No explicit new stock calls.
